verdict.rationale: Salv documents backtesting directly for transaction monitoring: any scenario version can be run against up to a year of your own history, with no real alerts raised, to see what it would have caught (salv-docs-26). It also supports drafting and adjusting scenarios before go-live (salv-docs-23), the same draft-and-test-on-history workflow for screening flows (salv-docs-16), and a separate sandbox environment (salv-docs-7). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth first-party documentation of the backtest workflow and result reporting beyond product-page claims.
